entries.speaker: Shadow Nejima
entries.en: Hahaha! I'm strong! I'm the most[n]powerful!

entries.speaker: Shadow Nejima
entries.en: Ain't no matter what you throw my way,[n]you won't put a scratch on me!

entries.speaker: Shadow Nejima
entries.en: I told you it's useless! There's no way[n]you can win against me!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ngh! The fact he's an infamous cheater[n]isn't just for show...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's no good if we continue this! Let's[n]withdraw once and come up with a[n]countermeasure!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Look at him, acting all smug because[n]of his cheats...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We can't do anything to him at this rate[n]though. Let's retreat for now and[n]rethink our approach.
